in_sanskrit.name: महीत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who possesses wealth and power

in_marathi.name: Mahit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘maha’ meaning ‘great’ or ‘mighty’ and ‘it’ meaning ‘he’ or ‘this’. Mahit is a powerful name that represents strength, courage, and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Mahit is also the name of the god of death, Yama.
